scope: Unchanged stock A0 inputs and drivers, same-host interleaved samples. Clang incumbent is C emitted from the same program compiled with -O3 -march=native. No cross-machine timing comparison.

primary.memoryMeaning: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in each fresh native process after the stock timer stops. Zero values are unavailable, not zero memory. Static stack allocation is the largest subq from rsp, excluding pushes and callers.
primary.startupMeaning: Fresh process wall time with one stock-driver iteration; includes launch and teardown.
